presets.name: Classic Starter
presets.description: Four colors, familiar basic heroes, straightforward combat and spell play.

presets.name: Green Assault
presets.description: Drow and Lycan strengthen your board. Savage Wolves grow after combat; Thunderhide Pack breaks towers.

presets.name: Blue / Black Control
presets.description: Zeus and Phantom Assassin threaten heroes. Use cross-lane damage, removal and board clears to control combat.

presets.name: Red / Green Alliance
presets.description: Sven and Pugna lead Mazzie's improvements, Viper's poison and Chen's converts; creeps that grow after combat back them up.

presets.name: Red / Blue Retaliation
presets.description: Timbersaw, Ursa and Centaur Warrunner strip armor and punish attackers; Zeus and J'Muy add burn, card draw and redirection.

presets.name: Red / Black Champions
presets.description: Legion Commander duels, Bristleback and Tidehunter hold the lane, Beastmaster's beasts weaken blockers and Phantom Assassin finishes heroes.

presets.name: Green / Blue Fortress
presets.description: Treant Protector, Enchantress and Dark Seer armor, heal and reposition the board; Zeus and J'Muy control it with spells.

presets.name: Green / Black Conquest
presets.description: Magnus, Abaddon and Omniknight empower, shield and heal; Debbi and Phantom Assassin remove the heroes in their way.

presets.name: Blue Eclipse
presets.description: Luna charges Eclipses while Crystal Maiden and Ogre Magi refill mana and copy spells; J'Muy and Zeus add card draw and burn.

presets.name: Blue / Black Ambush
presets.description: Earthshaker and Outworld Devourer stun and imprison while Prellex's Barracks flood the lanes; Phantom Assassin and Debbi pick off heroes.

presets.name: Blue / Red Swarm
presets.description: Venomancer's Plague Wards, Meepo's clones and Call the Reserves crowd the lanes; Skywrath Mage, Centaur Warrunner and Ursa finish what is left.
